text: Strained yoghurt (labneh) is salted, rolled into balls and coated in dried herbs and spices, then air-dried and aged; it is often kept in olive oil.

steps.note: The cheese is rolled into balls of about 6 cm.

steps.name: coat
steps.note: The balls are coated in dried thyme, za'atar and Aleppo pepper.

processing.text: Strained yoghurt (S. thermophilus and L. delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus) is salted, rolled into balls, coated in herbs, then air-dried and aged.
